## Description
This template adds out three text files (STUDENTID_gb.txt, STUDENTID_devops.txt, and STUDENTID_sdlc.txt) with information about George Brown, 
the COMP3104 DevOps course, and the importance of DevOps in the SDLC. It also updates the README.md with our names, student ID, and GitHub link. 
All changes were made on our STUDENTID-Name branch across 10 commits.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project

- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
